description: Use when the user asks how far to trust the source behind an AI claim, or when you are weighing a vendor claim. Lists the sources Context Pill reads, with tier, trust score (posterior mean), its conservative lower bound (LB10) and the number of resolved tips. Every source starts at a neutral Beta(2,2) prior (trust 0.50) and moves when its claims are re-checked. Optionally filter by name.

name.description: Optional source name filter; may match more than one source. Leave empty to list all enabled sources.

name: list_sources
title: Source trust scores
